accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I think pigeons are hiding something.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is not yet a useful statement. What did a pigeon do?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Three of them were outside the window. I looked over, they looked back, and then they all left at once. That has the energy of a meeting ending.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Or they were pigeons outside a window.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is exactly what they would want you to think. I'm not saying they have a secret headquarters. I'm saying they have an arrangement. A little pigeon system. Information moves. Breadcrumbs are exchanged. Tiny hats are probably involved.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You added hats before collecting a second observation.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Fine. We collect observations. We point a camera at the window, let it watch for pigeons, and have the software mark when they arrive, leave, and do anything suspiciously coordinated.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: "Suspiciously coordinated" needs a less suspicious definition. If the camera sees several birds leave together, that records several birds leaving together. It does not establish an arrangement.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Agreed. But if it happens repeatedly, we have a pattern worth investigating. If it never happens again, I publicly apologize to the pigeons.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Good. Run it for a while, change nothing else, and do not print a pigeon interrogator.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I was going to print a neutral observation perch.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: For us. The pigeons must not know we're onto them.
